question: How many Pennsylvania counties have a population greater than 7800 or a population less than 40000000?
lesson: Single CountEntities call with or_conditions handles 'A or B' filters in one shot. NEVER call FilterEntities then count results -- limit=50 silently truncates and returns the wrong number. NEVER write UNION SPARQL by hand for OR conditions on the same attribute.

question: How many films were released after 2000 and have a duration greater than 120 minutes?
lesson: For an AND of two conditions on different attributes of the same concept, you can either (a) call FilterEntities to get the entity_ids matching one condition then CountEntities(entity_ids=..., attribute_name=..., attribute_value=..., operator=...) for the AND, or (b) call CountEntities twice and reason. Prefer (a) for correctness.
